title: Inverse image on the localizing categories
statement:
Fix distinct primes $p$ and $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p$. Let $Y,Y'$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$ and $g:Y'\to Y$ a $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be admissible: a finite commutative ring $A$ killed by a power of $\ell$, or $\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, where $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite and $\mathcal O_E$ is its valuation ring. Use the condensed coefficient sheaves, unbounded derived categories, and small direct sums of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. For $\Lambda=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, use specifically the condensed ring of continuous maps valued in some finite subextension [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. Write $\Dctf$ for bounded constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and $\Loc$ for their localizing closure [sk-def-localizing-closure].

The inverse image $g^*=Lg^*:D(Y_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Lambda)\to D(Y'_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},\Lambda)$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] is exact as a triangulated functor [def-weil-triangulated-category], preserves arbitrary small direct sums, maps $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$ into $\Dctf(Y',\Lambda)$, and hence restricts to an exact sum-preserving functor $\Loc(\Dctf(Y,\Lambda))\to\Loc(\Dctf(Y',\Lambda))$.

proof.text: Transport the triangulated structure of the exact termwise derived functor along leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory, using precisely the canonical CommShift of the public statement. The derived adjunction supplies preservation of all existing coproducts, including empty coproducts.

The schemes are qcqs by the finite-type and separated structure maps. Pull back their finite constructible stratifications using Scheme.Stratification.pullback, then apply new-unbounded-pullback-finite-constant-local-model on each stratum. Transport along the square composition isomorphism to obtain constructibility. Exactness gives the cohomology comparison and boundedness; use constructibility invariance under isomorphism.

For every commutative condensed coefficient, choose a bounded flat representative using exists_iso_Q_obj_flat_of_torAmplitudeIn. Inverse image preserves flat terms via inverseImageModule_preservesFlat and the invertible coefficient comparison. Its termwise image retains both strict degree bounds. Apply torAmplitudeIn_Q_obj_of_flat and transport through the exact-derived comparison. This handles all six coefficients uniformly and avoids the separate ctf=bc theorem.

Use localizingClosure_exists to obtain the triangulated and replete localizing closures. The inverse image of the target closure under Lg* is localizing and contains the generators, so the defining intersection yields the object inclusion. The inherited full-subcategory lift is triangulated. Its inclusion preserves small coproducts by closure, and the target inclusion reflects them. Extend preservation from the Hom universe to all existing larger coproducts: distinct nonzero summands give distinct coordinate idempotents in the endomorphisms of the coproduct; shrink that support and use that omitted summands are zero.

split_report.summary: Second reading checked the current statements and sources, clarified the finite-subextension algebraic-closure coefficient, expanded the exact-derived identification and functorial flat-resolution construction, and retained all four proof steps. The finite case uses the generic bounded-flat-model construction to avoid assuming the global algebraic-closure finite-field datum. The imported field setting is made explicit; unit realization is left to maintenance because this item is only a component of the proper-base-change unit.
